_comment: What customers may ask MeshMesh to change through Fin. Checked against MeshMesh's CHANGESET before the customer is even asked to approve. Types are Salesforce Metadata API type names; a trailing * is a prefix match. Anything not in allowed_types is refused (fail closed). Edits take effect on the next request, no restart needed.
_blocked_comment: Refused even if added to allowed_types by mistake. Code, profiles and org-wide security need a human admin. Flow is excluded because MeshMesh flow support is experimental.
_modify_comment: Types whose EXISTING components may be changed. Everything else may only be created, so an existing field can never be silently overwritten (PoC finding T4).
_watch_comment: Snapshot before the build and compare after it: any component of these types that changed but is not in the approved CHANGESET makes the result needs_review instead of succeeded.
_code_comment: Custom code and Flows through Fin. Only NEW components, only in the org kinds listed in code_org_types (the bridge checks the org itself), always with tests for Apex. Flows are deployed inactive unless flow_activate is true. Set code_enabled to false to block all of it again.
